# REDIS // SENTINEL HA OPERATIONS CENTER
**Mission:** protect Redis availability, replication integrity, Sentinel quorum and datastore safety.

**Signal code:** 🟢 healthy · 🟡 investigate · 🔴 action required  |  Default jobs: `redis` and `redis-sentinel`  |  Use the filters above to isolate a node or monitored master.

panels.title: Redis Fleet Availability
panels.description: Percentage of selected Redis exporter targets reporting redis_up=1.

panels.title: Sentinel Fleet Availability
panels.description: Percentage of selected Sentinel exporter targets reporting redis_up=1.

panels.title: Redis Master Count
panels.description: Exactly one Redis node must advertise role=master. Two or more is a split-brain signal.

panels.title: Sentinel CKQUORUM
panels.description: Worst current CKQUORUM result across selected Sentinels and monitored masters.

panels.title: Sentinel Master Health
panels.description: Worst Sentinel view of the monitored master. All selected Sentinels should report healthy.

panels.title: Healthy Sentinels
panels.description: Lowest number of healthy Sentinels reported for the selected master. Includes the reporting Sentinel.

panels.title: Evictions / Second
panels.description: Any sustained eviction is critical for a Redis-backed Kamailio datastore because active state can be silently lost.

panels.title: Peak Memory Pressure
panels.description: Highest memory usage as a percentage of configured maxmemory among selected Redis nodes.

panels.title: Redis Node Roles
panels.description: Current role, Redis version and maxmemory policy for every selected data node.

targets.expr: max by (instance, role, redis_version, maxmemory_policy) (redis_instance_info{job=~"$redis_job", instance=~"$redis_instance"})

panels.title: Sentinel Master Election
panels.description: Deduplicated address that Sentinel currently considers master. All views should converge on one address.

panels.title: Consensus Capacity
panels.description: Healthy Sentinels and replicas compared with the configured quorum requirement.

panels.title: Sentinel Agreement Timeline
panels.description: Per-Sentinel master health and CKQUORUM state. A red lane identifies which Sentinel disagrees or cannot form quorum.

panels.title: Failover Epoch & Master Ping
panels.description: Config epoch increments on failover. Ping age shows how recently Sentinel received a healthy master response.

panels.title: Connected Replicas
panels.description: Number of connected replicas reported by each Redis node. The active master should match the intended HA topology.

panels.title: Replica Link Health
panels.description: Master link state on Redis replicas. Master nodes do not expose this metric.

panels.title: Replica Offset Gap
panels.description: Byte gap between the master replication offset and each replica offset. Sustained growth means the replica is falling behind.

panels.title: Replica Lag Reported by Master
panels.description: Lag in seconds for every replica, measured from the master-side replica record.

panels.title: Replication Offsets
panels.description: Master and replica replication offsets. Curves should advance together during writes.

panels.title: Resynchronization Events
panels.description: Full resyncs are expensive; partial resync denials often indicate backlog or connectivity problems.

panels.title: Memory Utilization by Node
panels.description: Used memory divided by configured maxmemory. Investigate above 75%; treat 85% as urgent.

panels.title: Memory Footprint
panels.description: Logical Redis memory, RSS, peak memory and configured maxmemory per node.

panels.title: Memory Fragmentation
panels.description: RSS-to-allocated fragmentation ratio. Persistent values above 1.5 or below 1.0 deserve investigation.

panels.title: Keys by Database
panels.description: Current key count per Redis database and node.

panels.title: Key Safety Events
panels.description: Evictions indicate memory pressure; expirations show normal TTL churn. Evictions should remain exactly zero.

panels.title: Keyspace Hit Ratio
panels.description: Cache-style signal that is still useful for spotting rising misses or premature key loss in a datastore workload.

panels.title: Operations Throughput
panels.description: Instantaneous operations per second reported by each Redis node.

panels.title: Processed Commands
panels.description: Prometheus-derived command throughput from the cumulative processed command counter.

panels.title: Network Throughput
panels.description: Redis network input and output rate by node.

panels.title: Client Connections
panels.description: Connected and blocked clients. Blocked clients should usually stay near zero.

panels.title: Connection Health
panels.description: New connection rate and rejected connection rate. Any rejection is operationally significant.

panels.title: Redis CPU Consumption
panels.description: Redis process CPU consumption expressed as CPU cores used (user + system seconds per second).

panels.title: Top Commands by Rate
panels.description: Command-level throughput across the selected Redis fleet.

panels.title: Average Command Execution Time
panels.description: Average server-side command execution time derived from command duration and call counters.

panels.title: RDB Last Save Status
panels.description: Status of the last RDB background save on each node.

panels.title: AOF State
panels.description: Whether Append Only File persistence is enabled on each node.

panels.title: Age of Last RDB Save
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful RDB save. Interpret together with the configured persistence policy.

panels.title: Unsaved Changes
panels.description: Number of changes since the last RDB save on each Redis node.

panels.title: Persistence Duration
panels.description: RDB save and AOF rewrite durations. Spikes can correlate with latency and memory pressure.

panels.title: AOF Size & Rewrite State
panels.description: Current/base AOF size and rewrite activity. Visible only when AOF is enabled.

panels.title: Persistence Activity
panels.description: Background save, AOF rewrite and Redis loading states.

panels.title: Sentinel Runtime State
panels.description: Number of monitored masters and Sentinel TILT state per selected Sentinel.

panels.title: Master Reachability from Sentinel
panels.description: Elapsed seconds since each Sentinel last received a healthy PING reply from the monitored master.

panels.title: Failover Policy Settings
panels.description: Sentinel failover timeout, down-after interval and parallel-sync count. Differences between Sentinels indicate configuration drift.

panels.title: Sentinel Script Queue
panels.description: Running Sentinel scripts and queued scripts. Persistent growth suggests a blocked notification or reconfiguration hook.

panels.title: Sentinel Healthy Replicas
panels.description: Healthy replicas observed by each Sentinel for the selected monitored master.

panels.title: Sentinel Healthy Peers
panels.description: Healthy Sentinel count observed by each Sentinel. This value includes the reporting Sentinel.

panels.title: Exporter Scrape Duration
panels.description: Time spent by each exporter collecting Redis or Sentinel metrics.

panels.title: Exporter Scrape Errors
panels.description: Error state for Redis and Sentinel exporter collection. The label may include the current error message.

panels.title: Redis Uptime
panels.description: Redis process uptime per selected data node. A reset marks a restart or replacement.
